title: Prompt regression gate (eval-driven prompt dev)

phases.notes: docs/design/mdu-09-prompt-regression-gate.md — D1-D12. Ordered-trace golden cases (order matters, presence does not), committed baseline, single gate script, promptfoo recipe, orchestrator clause in three prompt mirrors, routing table verified against opencode.json.

Slice A: scripts/lib/prompt_regression.py (cases|snapshot|diff|gate|baseline|check-config), evals/golden/cases.json (7 cases), evals/golden/baseline.json, evals/tasks/04-prompt-golden-cases/. Slice B: evals/README.md protocol, evals/promptfoo.yaml + evals/promptfoo_driver.sh, .github/workflows/ci.yml gate 5, three prompt clauses, 4 validate.py ROLE_KEYWORDS tuples, overlay re-exec wrapper, regenerated overlay build/.
REJECT with an ordered 10-item fix list (F1 promptfoo config did not run, F4 secret_scan git-SHA blind spot, plus F2/F3/F5 and nit items). Evidence in /tmp/opencode/mdu-09/review-evidence.md.

Re-review after fix cycle 1: F1-F5 all closed, but 3 new MAJOR defects (snapshot-write OSError handler passed an invalid reasons= kwarg to _fail; baseline anti-tamper vacuous for hand-edited non-pass values; diff did no snapshot-shape validation) plus 2 MINOR (absolute target path escaped the repo root; tab-indented YAML accepted) and 6 NIT.

Fix cycle 1 (10 items from the pro review) and fix cycle 2 (13 items: 3 MAJOR, 2 MINOR, 6 NIT, plus un-xfailing the two known-defect tests). Fix cycle 3 polish by just-code (budget): stale test comment, empty-cases list now an operational error, overlay wrapper docstring, explicit vars.task pattern.
APPROVE after fix cycle 2 — all 13 fixes verified real, no new fail-open path, 4 cosmetic NITs raised. Narrow re-review after the polish cycle: APPROVE, all 4 NITs verified, no weakened assertions.

tests/test_mdu_09_prompt_regression.py (base) and tests/test_mdu_09_overlay_prompt_regression.py (overlay). Order sensitivity, case deletion, gutted/tampered baseline, trace<2, path traversal, flow-YAML/unsupported shapes, --live SKIP, promptfoo binding, marker uniqueness, exit-code contract, overlay re-exec. Added a zero-case regression test after the review.

Live phase. Overlay wrapper re-exec proven three ways (source, identical --help diff, snapshot root == base tree); gate/check-config/cases/snapshot/diff exit 0 in both repos; both ./build.sh green; secret_scan clean on the six MDU-09 files; CI gate 5 wiring verified (path filters, fail-safe diff, no npm).

QA GRADE: PASS. AC-1 protocol doc cross-checked against the CLI with every documented command executed. AC-2 demonstrated on a scratch copy: reordered orchestrator loop steps -> gate exit 1 naming orchestrator-responsibilities-loop-order; tampered/gutted baseline -> exit 2; missing baselined case -> exit 1. AC-3 live promptfoo run: 3 passed (100%).

Branch mdu-09-prompt-regression-gate in both repos; secret_scan --staged clean in the base and the secret-scrub checklist plus the base scanner run non-forked in the overlay; base committed and pushed, overlay committed and pushed, main fast-forwarded in both. The push to main triggered CI run 39701688115, which succeeded with gate 5 (prompt regression gate) executing on the real tree; ci_green recorded by a follow-up commit, as for MDU-11.

summary: MDU-09 shipped: an eval-driven prompt regression gate (7 ordered golden traces, committed baseline, fail-closed exit contract) wired into CI and into three orchestrator prompt mirrors; reviewed to APPROVE across three review rounds, 380 base + 93 overlay tests green, QA PASS against AC-1/AC-2/AC-3 with a live 3-task promptfoo run.
